svg.title: Real wiring against its shuffle as questions concentrate on a few odour channels
svg.desc: Two panels, left and right hemisphere. Lines for questions concentrated on the channels the real wiring over-connects (matched) and on the opposite channels (mismatched). The prediction was that the matched line would rise above the +2.5% margin. In the left hemisphere it falls to -7.17%; in the right it rises to +1.62%, below the margin and below the mismatched line.
svg.text: Shaded band: the +2.5% gain the idea needed to show.
